max pause ms.label: Maximum dark pause (ms)
max pause ms.description: Limits completely dark RGB-source pauses to 0–2000 ms; default 500 ms. Starts one fresh ring on a mapped LED while preserving movement speed. At 0 the next ring starts without a dark pause. Output brightness, power and a black palette still apply.

controlMetadataNotes: Factory scene currently uses native RingsEffect, not renderRipple; use native control metadata. WLED Overlay (option 2) is not ported in the legacy implementation either.

speed.label: Speed
speed.description: Changes how quickly new colors move away from the center.

effect intensity.label: Sound effect
effect intensity.description: Changes how strongly the audio level affects brightness.

custom 1.label: Low bin
custom 1.description: Sets the lower frequency bound to 80 + 3 times this value, in Hz.

custom 2.label: High bin
custom 2.description: Sets the upper frequency bound to 80 + 42 times this value, in Hz.

custom 3.label: Pre-amp
custom 3.description: Changes audio gain; the renderer uses values from 1 to 31.

output.label: Output level
output.description: Scales the output of this scene.

controlMetadataNotes: WLED Low bin/High bin are currently mapped to 80+3*custom1 / 80+42*custom2 Hz, not literal FFT bin indices.
WLED Musical Scale checkbox is implemented as logarithmic frequency-to-hue mapping; do not claim chromatic-note quantisation.
custom 3 descriptor range is 0..255, but renderer clamps it to 1..31; values above 31 are indistinguishable.
